subject: Cognitive Science
title: The Bias Blind Spot
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Bias Blind Spot.

hook.text: You think you're less biased than average. That belief? It's itself a bias. Welcome to the blind spot.

buildup.text: The bias blind spot: seeing bias in others while believing yourself to be objective and rational.

discovery.text: Emily Pronin showed that people spot biases in others instantly but deny the same biases in themselves.

twist.text: Knowing about biases doesn't reduce them. People who score high on bias knowledge still show the blind spot.

climax.text: The fix isn't awareness alone—it's processes that check decisions regardless of how objective you feel.

punchline.text: Thinking you're unbiased is the biggest bias of all.

quiz.question: What is the bias blind spot?
options: Seeing bias in others but not in yourself
Being aware of all your biases
